method_meta_title: Historic Motor Car Research, Provenance & Assessment
method_meta_description: Historic motor car research and assessment: provenance, documentary evidence, originality, restoration history and acquisition support.
method_mandate_p1: The starting point is the particular motor car you have in mind and the qualities that make it interesting to you.
method_mandate_p2: A maker and model give the search its broad outline. Period, coachwork, specification, provenance, originality and restoration history help define the individual example you are seeking.
method_mandate_p3: We discuss your expectations regarding condition and intended use, together with the geographical scope, timescale and financial parameters of the search.
method_mandate_p4: These requirements form the mandate and guide the assessment of each candidate.
method_research_p1: The search may lead through private owners, collectors, specialist dealers, marque clubs, restorers, auction offerings and historical archives.
method_research_p2: Depending on the motor car, I pursue enquiries through these sources and investigate leads arising from personal contacts.
method_research_p3: When a possible candidate emerges, I establish what can be learned about its history, specification and availability. The findings help us decide whether the car deserves closer examination.
method_evidence_p1: I examine the records associated with an individual motor car to establish its history and identity.
method_evidence_p2: Ownership and registration documents, period correspondence, photographs, invoices, coachbuilder records and restoration documentation can each contribute important information.
method_evidence_p3: I compare these sources, investigate discrepancies and consider how the surviving documentation relates to the motor car itself.
method_evidence_p4: Some conclusions can be firmly established through documentary evidence. Others depend on historical interpretation or require further investigation. I explain these distinctions and the significance of any remaining questions.
method_motor_car_p1: The motor car itself provides another source of historical evidence.
method_motor_car_p2: Its identity, surviving original components, coachwork, period specification, alterations and restoration history reveal how the individual car has developed over its lifetime.
method_motor_car_p3: I consider these characteristics alongside the documentation and examine how much of the car's historical character has survived.
method_motor_car_p4: Originality, preservation, restoration quality and mechanical condition each require careful consideration. Their importance also depends on the collector's expectations and intended use.
method_motor_car_p5: Where specialist technical examination is appropriate, I can coordinate an inspection and discuss the findings with you.
method_judgement_p1: My assessment brings together the motor car's history, its present condition, the available evidence and the requirements established in the collector's mandate.
method_judgement_p2: I explain the strengths of each promising candidate, the questions that deserve attention and the implications of the findings.
method_judgement_p3: The resulting recommendation may be to undertake further research, proceed to negotiations, reject the candidate or continue searching.
method_judgement_p4: I explain the reasons for my judgement so that you can decide how to proceed.
method_acquisition_p1: When you decide to pursue a particular motor car, I can assist with communication with its owner or seller, examination of additional records and coordination of specialist inspections.
method_acquisition_p2: My involvement may extend to negotiations, examination of acquisition documents and practical arrangements for transfer.
method_acquisition_p3: Throughout the process, I seek to clarify the material questions concerning the car and its acquisition, allowing you to make an informed decision.
method_acquisition_p4: We agree on the extent of my involvement according to the circumstances of the individual motor car.
method_acquisition_p5: You can {#link}make a private enquiry{/link} to discuss a possible engagement.
